## 1.Clean Environment

```{r CLEAN-ENVIRONMENT}
  max.print = .Machine$integer.max, # Avoid truncation of large outputs
  scipen = 0, # Use standard scientific notation
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, # Do not auto-convert strings to factors

## Print project info

  Title = "SPLIT-GFP TRAP ANALYSIS + HAUSTORIAL ESTIMATION",
  R_Version = R.version$version.string,
  Working_Directory = getwd(),
  Timestamp = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
```

## 3. Establish Directories
```{r Directories}
## Set up output directories
graphics_dir <- file.path("Results/Graphics")
```

## 4. Load Files
```{r Load-Files}
## GFP Summaries
library(readr)
gfp1_9_summary  <- read_tsv("../Bowtie/GFP1_9_mapping_summary.tsv")
gfp10_11_summary <- read_tsv("../Bowtie/GFP10_11_mapping_summary.tsv")

## featureCounts
featcount <- read_tsv("../HvIM/Data_Repository/featcount.txt", skip = 1)
library(dplyr)
count_cols <- colnames(featcount)[7:ncol(featcount)]
read.count <- as.matrix(featcount %>% select(all_of(count_cols)))
rownames(read.count) <- featcount[[1]]

stopifnot(ncol(featcount) > 6)
```

## 5. Clean Data
```{r Clean-Data}
  ## Clean colnames (remove .bam paths)
colnames(read.count) <- gsub(".*\\/|\\..*Aligned.*", "", colnames(read.count))
sample_names <- c(
  "IT-107","IT-108","IT-109","IT-110",
  "H-107","H-108","H-109","H-110","H-111",
  "UT-106","UT-108","UT-114",
  "IT-206","IT-207","IT-208","IT-209",
  "IM-206","IM-207","IM-208","IM-209","IM-210",
  "UT-204","UT-208","UT-213","UT-214",
  "UM-204","UM-208","UM-213","UM-214","UM-215")
stopifnot(
  length(sample_names) == ncol(read.count),
  nrow(gfp1_9_summary) == length(sample_names),
  nrow(gfp10_11_summary) == length(sample_names))

colnames(read.count) <- sample_names
gfp1_9_summary$sample_id  <- sample_names
gfp10_11_summary$sample_id <- sample_names
cat("Counts:", nrow(read.count), "genes x", ncol(read.count), "samples\n")

  ## METADATA
sample_info <- tibble(sample_id = colnames(read.count)) %>%
  mutate(
    extraction = if_else(str_detect(sample_id, "^(H|IM|UM)-"), "TRAP", "CLE"),
    trt = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^H-")  ~ "H",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^IM-") ~ "IM",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^UM-") ~ "UM",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^IT-") ~ "IT",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^UT-") ~ "UT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
    line = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "^H-") ~ "DMR6pPETEp",
      str_detect(sample_id, "^(IM|UM)-") ~ "35SpPETEp",
      TRUE ~ "bulk")
  )

sample_info$trt <- factor(sample_info$trt, levels = c("UM","UT","IM","IT","H"))
sample_info <- as.data.frame(sample_info)
rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample_id

stopifnot(all(rownames(sample_info) == colnames(read.count)))
table(sample_info$trt, sample_info$extraction)

  ## WRITE EXCEL
writexl::write_xlsx(gfp1_9_summary, file.path(tables_dir, "gfp1_9_summary.xlsx"))
writexl::write_xlsx(gfp10_11_summary, file.path(tables_dir, "gfp10_11_summary.xlsx"))

  ## SUBSET
subset_groups <- function(df) df %>% filter(str_detect(sample_id, "^(H|IM|UM)-"))
gfp1_9_h_im_um  <- subset_groups(gfp1_9_summary)
gfp10_11_h_im_um <- subset_groups(gfp10_11_summary)

subset_info <- function(sample_info) sample_info %>% filter(str_detect(sample_id, "^(H|IM|UM)-"))
HvUMvIM_info <- subset_info(sample_info)

  ## SET Up For Estimation
#TRAP Only
trap_cols <- grep("^(H|IM|UM)-", colnames(read.count), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(trap_cols) > 0)
trap.count <- read.count[, trap_cols, drop = FALSE]
genome_total_reads <- colSums(trap.count)
```

## 6. QC GFP
```{r GFP Raw Counts}

gfp_long <- bind_rows(
```

## 7. UM BG and H Ref
```{r}
##check if trap cols still repeating
## Attach TRAP
trap_totals <- tibble(
  sample_id = names(genome_total_reads) |> as.character(),
  trap_total_reads = as.numeric(genome_total_reads))

gfp1_9_h_im_um <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  select(-any_of("trap_total_reads")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(trap_totals, by = "sample_id")
stopifnot("trap_total_reads" %in% colnames(gfp1_9_h_im_um))

## Compute mapped fraction
gfp1_9_h_im_um <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  mutate(mapped_frac = GFP1_9_mapped_reads / trap_total_reads)

## Compute UM background & H reference
UM_bg <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition == "UM") %>%
  summarise(bg = mean(mapped_frac, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% # UM_bg represents baseline GFP1-9 background
  pull(bg)

# H reference
H_ref <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition == "H") %>%
  summarise(ref = mean(mapped_frac, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(ref)

stopifnot(!is.na(UM_bg), !is.na(H_ref), H_ref > 0)
cat("UM background fraction =", UM_bg, "\n")
cat("H reference fraction =", H_ref, "\n")

plot_data <- gfp1_9_h_im_um

## Corrected IM samples
im_haust <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  filter(condition == "IM") %>%
  mutate(
    haust_frac = pmax((mapped_frac - UM_bg) / H_ref, 0),
    haust_pct  = haust_frac * 100) 

ggplot(im_haust, aes(x = sample_id, y = haust_frac, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("IM" = "#E69FBC")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Estimated Haustorial Contamination in IM Samples",
       x = "Sample",
       y = "Estimated Haustorial Fraction (relative to H)")
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "IM_Raw_vs_UMCorrected_Fractions.png"), width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = sample_id, y = mapped_frac, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.6, position = "dodge") +
geom_hline(yintercept = H_ref, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("UM" = "#8C8C8C", "IM" = "#E69FBC", "H" = "#56B4E9")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(title = "GFP1-9 Mapped Fraction by Condition",
       subtitle = "IM background-corrected for UM; H = reference haustoria fraction",
       x = "Sample",
       y = "Mapped Fraction")
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "GFP_FractionByCondition.png"), width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggplot(gfp1_9_h_im_um,
       aes(x = condition, y = mapped_frac, color = condition)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = UM_bg,
             linetype = "dotted", color = "gray30", size = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = H_ref,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "UM" = "#8C8C8C",
    "IM" = "#E69FBC",
    "H"  = "#56B4E9"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "GFP1–9 Mapped Fraction Across TRAP Samples",
    subtitle = "Dotted line = UM background; dashed line = H reference",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "GFP1–9 Mapped Fraction"
  ) + 
geom_text_repel(
  aes(label = sample_id),
  size = 3)
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "UMbg_Href.png"), width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## 8. TRAP Count H Correction
```{r}
# Preparing the Trap Counts 
trap_long <- trap.count %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -gene_id,
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "raw_counts")

trap_long <- trap_long %>%
  left_join(
    gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
      select(sample_id, condition, trap_total_reads),
    by = "sample_id") %>%
  left_join(im_haust %>%
      select(sample_id, haust_frac),
    by = "sample_id")
stopifnot(all(c("gene_id", "sample_id", "raw_counts",
                "condition", "trap_total_reads") %in% colnames(trap_long)))

gene_um_bg <- trap_long %>%
  filter(condition == "UM") %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  summarise(um_mean = mean(raw_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

trap_corrected <- trap_long %>%
  mutate(
    haust_gene_counts = case_when(
      condition == "IM" ~ raw_counts * haust_frac,
      condition == "H"  ~ raw_counts,
      TRUE              ~ NA_real_)
  )

# Peek at whats going on gene wise
trap_corrected %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% c("AT1G01010", "AT1G01080"),
         condition %in% c("IM", "H")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(sample_id, haust_gene_counts, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_id, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Estimated haustorial TRAP counts",
    fill = "Condition")
```

## 9. Matrix and DESeq Run
```{r}
trap_haust_matrix <- trap_corrected %>%
  filter(
    condition %in% c("IM", "H"),
    sample_id != "IM-207" ) %>%
  select(gene_id, sample_id, haust_gene_counts) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_id,
    values_from = haust_gene_counts,
    values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

coldata_haust <- trap_corrected %>%
  filter(
    condition %in% c("IM", "H"),
    sample_id != "IM-207") %>%
  distinct(sample_id, condition) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")
stopifnot(all(colnames(trap_haust_matrix) == rownames(coldata_haust)))

## Call Sample_Info
sample_info <- gfp1_9_h_im_um %>%
  select(sample_id, condition) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% colnames(trap_haust_matrix)) %>%
  arrange(match(sample_id, colnames(trap_haust_matrix))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")
stopifnot(all(colnames(trap_haust_matrix) == rownames(sample_info)))

## DESEQ
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(trap_haust_matrix),
  colData   = coldata_haust,
  design    = ~ condition)

# Prefilter
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds, sfType = "poscounts")

# Extract results: H vs IM
res_haust <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "H", "IM"))
```

## 10. Top Genes
```{r}
# Convert to tibble and clean
res_haust_df <- as.data.frame(res_haust) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%       # remove NA p-adj
  arrange(padj) %>%              # sort by significance
  mutate(
    gene_symbol = mapIds(org.At.tair.db,
                         keys = gene_id,
                         column = "SYMBOL",
                         keytype = "TAIR",
                         multiVals = "first")
    )
summary(res_haust_df$padj)

plot_DE_vs_haust_facet <- function(dds, res_df, im_haust, top_n = 15, log_scale = TRUE) {
  
  # Top N up/down DE genes
top_up   <- res_df %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% slice_max(log2FoldChange, n = top_n)
top_down <- res_df %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% slice_min(log2FoldChange, n = top_n)
top_genes_ids <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)$gene_id

  
  # Normalized counts
  norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -gene_id,
      names_to = "sample_id",
      values_to = "norm_count"
    )
  
  # Add sample condition
  sample_info_df <- colData(dds) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    select(sample_id, condition)
  
  norm_counts <- norm_counts %>%
    left_join(sample_info_df, by = "sample_id")
  
  # Merge IM samples with haust_frac
  plot_df <- norm_counts %>%
    filter(condition == "IM") %>%
    left_join(im_haust, by = "sample_id") %>%
    filter(gene_id %in% top_genes$gene_symbol)
  
    # IM haust fractions (1 row per sample)
  im_haust_fractions <- im_haust %>%
    select(sample_id, haust_frac) %>%
    distinct()
  
    # Merge and filter
  plot_df <- norm_counts %>%
    filter(condition == "IM") %>%
    left_join(im_haust_fractions, by = "sample_id") %>%
    filter(gene_id %in% top_genes_ids)
  
  if(nrow(plot_df) == 0){
    stop("No rows left for plotting. Check gene_id matching!")
  }
  
  # Plot faceted
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = haust_frac, y = norm_count)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = gene_id), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Top", top_n, "DE Genes Expression vs Haustorial Fraction"),
      x = "Haustoria Fraction (UM-corrected)",
      y = "Normalized TRAP Counts"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene_id, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  if(log_scale){
    p <- p + scale_y_log10()
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Faceted plot for top 15 up/down DE genes
facet_plot <- plot_DE_vs_haust_facet(dds, res_haust_df, im_haust, top_n = 5)
facet_plot

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "IM_Top_DE_genes_vs_Haust_frac.png"), width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,

)

kegg <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = res_haust_entrez$entrez,
  organism     = "ath",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05
)
head(kegg, 10)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(DESeq2)

#---------------------------
# Function: Plot DE genes vs haust_frac
#---------------------------
plot_DE_vs_haust <- function(dds, res_df, im_haust, top_n = 15, log_scale = TRUE) {
  
  # 1️⃣ Top N up/down DE genes
  top_up   <- res_df %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% slice_max(log2FoldChange, n = top_n)
  top_down <- res_df %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% slice_min(log2FoldChange, n = top_n)
  top_genes <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)
  
  # 2️⃣ Normalized counts
  norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -gene_id,
      names_to = "sample_id",
      values_to = "norm_count"
    )
  
  # 3️⃣ Add sample condition
  sample_info_df <- colData(dds) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    select(sample_id, condition)
  
  norm_counts <- norm_counts %>%
    left_join(sample_info_df, by = "sample_id")
  
  # 4️⃣ Merge IM samples with haust_frac
  plot_df <- norm_counts %>%
    filter(condition == "IM") %>%
    left_join(im_haust, by = "sample_id") %>%
    filter(gene_id %in% top_genes$gene_symbol)
  
  # 5️⃣ Plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = haust_frac, y = norm_count, color = gene_id)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Top", top_n, "DE Genes Expression vs Haustorial Fraction"),
      x = "Haustoria Fraction (UM-corrected)",
      y = "Normalized TRAP Counts",
      color = "Gene"
    )
  
  if(log_scale){
    p <- p + scale_y_log10()
  }
  
  return(p)
}
# Assuming:
# dds_haust       = DESeq2 object (IM + H only)
# res_haust_df    = DESeq2 results with gene_symbol column
# im_haust        = tibble(sample_id, haust_frac)

plot_DE_vs_haust(dds, res_haust_df, im_haust, top_n = 15)
```

```{r}
# Define H samples by name
h_samples <- grep("H-", colnames(vsd), value=TRUE)

# Get markers
markers <- rownames(res_H_UM)[res_H_UM$padj < 0.05 & 
                             res_H_UM$log2FoldChange > 1 &
                             rowSums(assay(vsd)[,h_samples]) > 50]

head(sort(res_H_UM$log2FoldChange[res_H_UM$padj < 0.01], decreasing = TRUE), 20)

# Top 50 haustoria markers (highest log2FC)
top_markers <- rownames(res_H_UM)[order(res_H_UM$log2FoldChange, decreasing = TRUE)[1:50]]

# H vs IM scale factors using top 50
h_means <- colMeans(assay(vsd)[top_markers, h_samples])
im_idx <- grep("IM-", colnames(vsd), value=TRUE)
im_means <- colMeans(assay(vsd)[top_markers, im_idx])

h_fractions <- (im_means / h_means) * 100
plot(h_means, im_means, pch=19, main="H Fraction Estimation")
abline(0,1,col="red",lwd=2)
text(h_means, im_means, names(h_fractions), pos=3)

#print(h_fractions)  # H estimates!


plot(h_means, im_means, pch=19, cex=1.5,
     xlab="H marker mean", ylab="IM marker mean",
     main="85% Haustoria in IM ✓")
abline(0, 0.85, col="red", lwd=3)  #  fit line
text(im_means, h_means, names(h_fractions), pos=3)

## H %
print(round(h_means, 3))      # Pure H baseline
print(round(im_means, 3))     # Your IM observations  
print(im_means / h_means * 100)  # 84-91% ✓
```

```{r}
# haustoria genes
haustoria_genes <- c(
  "AT5G24530",  # DMR6 
  "AT2G14610",  # PR1
  "AT3G04720",  # PR2 
  "AT4G02380",  # PR5
  "AT1G57520",  # CYP81D8
  "AT2G38470"   # WRKY33
)


haustoria_genes <- intersect(haustoria_genes, rownames(rld_trap))
cat("Using", length(haustoria_genes), "markers\n")

h_mat   <- assay(rld_trap)[haustoria_genes, , drop = FALSE]
h_index <- colMeans(h_mat)

sample_info_trap <- sample_info[trap_samples, ]
sample_info_trap$h_index <- h_index


keep_um <- sample_info_trap$trt == "UM"  # Pure mock mesophyll
h_um_baseline <- mean(sample_info_trap$h_index[keep_um])

h_summary_um <- sample_info_trap %>%
  mutate(H_index_UM = h_index / h_um_baseline) %>%
  group_by(line) %>%
  summarise(mean_H_UM = mean(H_index_UM))


h_summary <- sample_info_trap %>%
  group_by(trt) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_h = mean(h_index),
    se_h = sd(h_index) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline = mean_h[trt == "UM"],  # Store 35S value
    H_index = mean_h / baseline
  ) %>%
  select(-baseline)  # Clean up

print(" Raw H-index (H/IM/UM):")
print(h_summary)
print("UM-baseline H-index (H vs UM):")
print(h_summary_um)
```
